title: fix(spec): a translation item is named in snake_case, the locale tag goes in `locale`
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBGfQhhK2rkH91cc4DbNzUXk)_

Fixes #26128

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:翻译条目 `name` 的说明改为 snake_case(如 `zh_cn`),语言标签写在 `locale`;不再建议用 `zh-CN` 作条目名。保存门与读侧回退行为不变。
- 为什么改:旧说明叫作者用 `zh-CN` 命名,而保存门的条目名语法拒收它(400 INVALID_REQUEST),照规范写的作者第一次保存必失败。
- 风险与回滚:仅文案与一条门禁测试,无接受集变化;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`(name 的 describe 与上方注释)、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.item-name-grammar.test.ts`(新增 #26128 段)、`packages/core/src/fallbacks/authored-translation-sync.ts`(跳过警告文案)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.item-name-grammar.test.ts`,预期 27/27 通过,其中 `zh-CN` 被拒、`zh_cn` + `locale: 'zh-CN'` 保存成功。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `TranslationItemSchema.name` describe: `Item name — snake_case like every metadata item (e.g. \`zh_cn\`); the BCP-47 tag goes in \`locale\``. The comment above it now says the same and that the tag-shaped `row.name` fallback covers only rows stored before `locale` became required.
- `content/docs/references/system/translation.mdx`: the generated `name` row, regenerated with `gen:schema` + `gen:docs`.
- `authored-translation-sync.ts`: the no-locale skip warning now says `set the top-level 'locale' to its BCP-47 tag, e.g. 'zh-CN'` instead of suggesting the item be named after the tag. Behaviour unchanged (the existing test matches `no resolvable locale`).
- Door pin (`protocol.item-name-grammar.test.ts`): `saveMetaItem` of type `translation` named `zh-CN` is refused with `code: INVALID_REQUEST`, `status: 400` and the grammar message, persisting nothing; `zh_cn` with `locale: 'zh-CN'` saves and keeps the tag in `locale`.
- `refuseUngrammaticalMetaItemName` and the read-side fallback are untouched.
- Docs, skills and examples grep (`conventionally the locale`, `name the item after`, a `name: 'zh-CN'` translation item): no hits outside the files above.
- Changeset: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, `'@objectstack/core': patch` (the sync warn text).
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-publish-canonical-fold.test.ts` (about line 269): the test-helper comment now says the name is snake_case (`zh_cn`) with the tag in `locale`; its fixture already used `zh_cn`. Added in patch round r1 (claim surface amended 15:13Z).

## Tests

Tests ran on `33a1af012`; head `f308adfc4` is that commit plus a merge of `origin/main` (`a485b5a3e`) that touches none of these files.

- `metadata-protocol` `protocol.item-name-grammar.test.ts`: 27/27 (25 existing + 2 new).
- `spec` `src/system/translation.test.ts`: 182/182. `core` `src/fallbacks`: 67/67. `service-i18n` `authored-translations.test.ts`: 16/16.
- `metadata-protocol` full suite: 269 files passed, 3 skipped; 21582 tests passed, 19 skipped.
- r1, on `ad3a211fe`: `objectql` `protocol-publish-canonical-fold.test.ts` 10/10.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/spec/src/system/translation.test.ts` (about line 757) parses a schema-level item named `zh-CN`; the schema does not constrain `name`, so this stays valid at the schema and is not a door fixture. Left as is.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 106 derived families, run serially on `33a1af012`. 102 exited 0 on the first pass; 4 exited 3 (prerequisite: built output) and exited 0 after a full `pnpm turbo run build` (`check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`, `check:lean-entry-closure`).
- `--ran` reconciliation: `106 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 106 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. The derived list on head `f308adfc4` is byte-identical to the one on `33a1af012`.
- After the `os-regen-merge.sh` merge, on `f308adfc4`: spec build + `gen:schema` + `gen:docs` left the tree clean; `check:generated`, `check:docs`, `check:authorable-surface` exit 0.
- r1, head `ad3a211fe` (comment + changeset only): the derived list grew to 107 (`check-engine-split-ratio.mjs --self-test` added). The 23 families reading the changeset, objectql tests or repo-wide text were re-run on `ad3a211fe`, all exit 0; `--ran` over the merged record: `107 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 107 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- Full dogfood: not owed (no `!` in the title, no narrowing arm).
